cutByEar: take02 75-81 s isolated splat (reads as a click)
composite.cutByDetector: every transient >=12 dB over its local median in 1.5-5 kHz, and every honk, avoided by >=1.5 s

processing.loudnorm: two-pass linear, I=-23.87 LUFS, TP=-1.0 dBTP, LRA=11
processing.loopStartRationale: seamfit start; wrap step 0.12 dB, hole 4.1 dB against a natural 4.2 dB

chosenBy: Andrew by ear over five rounds, 2026-09-30: he loved the Guangzhou splatter, so honks, train horns, clicks and isolated splats were spliced out (his timestamps for the faint horns), and the final version approved: 'It's all good now'.

screened.byEar: five rounds; every stretch in the loop heard and cleared

notes: Splices are 4 s equal-power crossfades between clean stretches of three takes from the same Guangzhou hotel room. Seamless-looped to 409s with the fixed loop tool (real equal-power wrap crossfade).
